description: The bar chart illustrates the ratio (%) of knowledge perception across three large language models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, while the vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90% with increments of 10%. Each category contains three grouped bars, colored blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve high ratios of approximately 90%, while ChatGPT is slightly lower at around 73%. In the Songs category, Llama3 and Qwen2 again show high ratios, with Llama3 at about 84% and Qwen2 at 90%, while ChatGPT is lower at approximately 63%. In the Basketball category, all models show lower ratios, with Llama3 at about 67%, Qwen2 at 58%, and ChatGPT at around 62%. The chart suggests that knowledge perception varies significantly by topic, with Llama3 and Qwen2 generally performing better than ChatGPT in the higher-perceived knowledge categories.
